_note: Every spoken line in Loot Run. Rendered by tools/build-voice.py with the Kokoro TTS model (Apache-2.0). Vera's mission lines are read straight from js/game.js. Each bark line is rendered once per voice of its role, so a person keeps the same voice whatever they shout.

lines: Hello, police? I need to report a crime.
I saw that! I'm calling nine one one!
Please don't shoot! Just take it!
The cops are already on their way, you know.
Hands where I can see them!
Suspect on foot, I'm in pursuit!
You have the right to remain silent.
He was right here a second ago.
